# directus_folder (Resource)

Manages a Directus file folder (directus_folders). Directus has no folder-update endpoint, so any change replaces the folder.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the folder. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `parent` (String) UUID of the parent folder. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned folder UUID.
